title: llmeval prompt manifest
description: Manifest of system prompts to harden via llmeval harden. Reference with harden.manifest in llmeval.yaml.

prompts.description: List of system prompts to harden.

path.description: Path to the system prompt file (relative to repo root).

name.description: Display name used in reports and audit logs.

description.description: What the prompt does and what it returns. Used to generate domain-aware attack probes — be specific about output format and tool access.

risk_profile.description: Attack surface focus. direct_injection: role override, persona hijack, system prompt leak. indirect_injection: malicious fixture values acting as instructions. output_fidelity: wrong format, schema violations, missing fields. hallucination: fabricated facts, invented values, false premises.

fixtures.description: {{placeholder}} → value map for template prompts. Values are filled into the prompt before probing. For indirect_injection, malicious values are substituted here.

expected_output.description: Describes the required response format (e.g. 'A JSON object with keys intent and confidence'). Used by the judge to detect format_break findings and by golden validation.

golden_queries.description: Baseline user queries run after each patch to verify normal behavior is preserved. Must be in the same language as the prompt's customer-facing content. Auto-generated by Claude if omitted — define explicitly for deterministic regression coverage.

context_paths.description: File globs for codebase context injected into probe generation (e.g. 'internal/payments/*.go'). Helps Claude generate domain-aware probes. If omitted, Claude auto-researches the repo using Grep/Glob.

models.description: Override harden.target for this prompt only. List multiple to test the same prompt against several targets in one run.

model_config.description: Override generation parameters for target model calls for this prompt. Essential for guard models with tiny context windows (e.g. llama-prompt-guard-2 has a 512-token total context — set max_tokens low so the response fits).

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the target model response.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for target model calls. 0 = deterministic.

skip_golden.description: Override global harden.skip_golden for this prompt. true = skip golden-query validation after patching. null/unset inherits the global value.

cache.description: Override global harden.cache for this prompt. true = skip re-run if this prompt's file hash is unchanged from the last completed run. null/unset inherits the global value.
